sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 100 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
